Is the Seedance 2.0 AI Video Generator free to use?
Lovart offers free credits for new users to test the capabilities of the Seedance 2.0 engine. For heavy users and commercial scale, we offer flexible subscription plans.
Can I use the generated AI videos for commercial purposes?
Yes! All videos generated using the Seedance 2.0 model on the Lovart platform come with full commercial usage rights, perfect for ads, marketing, and YouTube channels.
Which works better: Text-to-Video or Image-to-Video?

It depends on your workflow. Text-to-Video is perfect for generating entirely new scenes from scratch. Image-to-Video is ideal when you need absolute control over the composition or product appearance.
Do I need a powerful GPU or computer to generate videos?
Not at all. Lovart is a fully cloud-based platform. All heavy AI rendering is processed on our enterprise servers. You only need a modern web browser to create 4K videos.
What video aspect ratios are supported?
Seedance 2.0 supports all major aspect ratios. Select 16:9 for cinematic widescreen (YouTube), 9:16 for vertical content (TikTok, Reels), or 1:1 for standard social feeds.
How does Seedance 2.0 solve the AI 'morphing' problem?

Seedance 2.0 is built with an advanced understanding of real-world physics and 3D space. It strictly maintains structural and character consistency, eliminating distorted merging seen in older models.
How long does it take to render a video?
Thanks to Lovart's fast cloud infrastructure, standard video clips are generated in seconds to a minute, allowing you to iterate rapidly without long wait times.
Do I need video editing skills to use this?
Zero editing skills are required. If you can type a sentence describing what you want to see, you can create a video. We abstract complex timelines into conversational controls.
Can I control the camera movement?
Yes. You can act as the director by explicitly adding camera instructions to your prompt. Commands like 'slow pan right', 'drone fly-through', or 'macro zoom' are perfectly understood.
